resources.string: Install this same app on the smart board and on your phone. The phone types with the keyboard built into this app (HeliBoard); the text appears on the board.
Turn on the built-in keyboard, scan the QR code the board shows, then type.
Enable Phone Keyboard and select it. Tapping any text box then shows a QR code instead of the on-screen keyboard.
Enabled: now select it as the active keyboard
Active: tap the box below to see the QR code
The phone typing keyboard is active here. On the board, select \"Phone Keyboard (pair with QR)\" instead.
Open Phone Keyboard on your phone and tap Scan (or scan this with the camera).
Phone connected: type on your phone
Scan the QR code on the smart board
That is not a Phone Keyboard pairing code.
Connected: typing goes to the board
Connected: tap a text box on the board
Code expired: scan the board again
Tap here and type. Your text goes to the board.
Turn on "Phone Keyboard: Type", the keyboard bundled in this app, to type.
Switch to "Phone Keyboard: Type" to type.
